payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about state-of-the-art baselines in the context of text-to-SQL generation, including comparisons with existing models and their performance metrics.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines in text-to-SQL generation include Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, which are adapted for context-dependent SQL generation across multiple domains.
Recent approaches achieving state-of-the-art performance include models that utilize recursive decoding and graph neural networks for encoding schemas.
The proposed model demonstrates a 7% improvement in question match accuracy over previous state-of-the-art methods by utilizing an editing mechanism for SQL generation.
